Verent Engine is Verent's config-driven client-automation engine — one engine runs any automation (lead follow-up, document drafts, missed-call handling, maintenance triage, quote intake, custom flows) for any client, driven entirely by a per-client JSON config.

Main entry points:
- `verent/store.py` — data core
- `verent/client.py` — config load/validate
- `verent/automations.py` — the engine (`run_automation`)
- `verent/providers.py` — model seam (`FakeProvider`/`ClaudeCliProvider`)
- `clients/*.json` — per-client config
- `web/console.py`, `web/cockpit.html` — UI
